narrative: The tiring-house, a little before two. The plot on the peg is Titus. The gown is on. Nothing pinned to it names a part. He is on the side the plot has given him. The yard is filling. The plot names the play. The gown does not name the man.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Was in Titus. The part was not named.

entities.name: Titus
entities.context: Shown on stage in In it, and not named
